user.title: WOOW Serial
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.external: External device bound from another integration (e.g. HA-WF485-V3)
menu_options.hub: Admin panel (monitor, devices and send log in the sidebar)

local.title: Add a port
local.description: Pick the RS485 / RS232 port to add. Ports that are already added are not listed.

serial.title: Serial port {port}
serial.description: Driver: {driver}. The line settings must match the device on the other end.

data.name: Name
data.loop_flush: Flush through internal loopback on open

data_description.frame_gap_ms: Silence that ends a received frame. 0 = automatic (24 character times, at least 20 ms; 25 ms at 9600 baud).
data_description.echo_filter: Half-duplex RS485 hears what it sends; drop that copy.
data_description.loop_flush: On open, push one byte round the UART's internal loopback so stale FIFO bytes never reach the wire.
data_description.line_ending: Appended to text sent with the Send text entity or the text field of the service.

external.title: External device
external.description: Pick the device that carries the RS485 / RS232 line. An HA-WF485-V3 fills the next page in by itself. Leave it empty to choose the entities by hand.

external_bind.title: Bind the external port
external_bind.description: Home Assistant sends by writing the bytes into the send entity, and treats every new value of the receive entity as a received frame.

data_description.tx_entity: A text entity that transmits what is written into it (HA-WF485-V3: HEX data TX).
data_description.rx_entity: An entity that shows each received frame (HA-WF485-V3: uart_net_hex).
data_description.idle_values: Comma-separated values that mean no data (HA-WF485-V3: IDLE).
data_description.status_entity: When this reads off, the port is shown as unavailable.

error.cannot_open: Cannot open the port (missing or in use).
error.same_entity: Sending and receiving need two different entities.

abort.no_ports: No free RS485 / RS232 port found.

data.loop_flush: Flush through internal loopback on open

data_description.frame_gap_ms: Silence that ends a received frame. 0 = automatic.
data_description.idle_values: Comma-separated values that mean no data (HA-WF485-V3: IDLE).

error.same_entity: Sending and receiving need two different entities.

send.name: Send (serial)
send.description: Send bytes on an RS485 / RS232 port (on-board or bound), optionally waiting for the reply frame.

config_entry_id.name: Port
config_entry_id.description: The serial port to send on.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text with \r \n \xHH escapes; the port's line ending is appended.

wait_ms.name: Wait for reply
wait_ms.description: 0 = do not wait. Otherwise return the next received frame (or timeout) as the response.

not_loaded.message: {entry} is not a loaded WOOW Serial port.

too_long.message: {name}: too much data; the bound entity takes at most {limit} characters.

no_payload.message: Nothing to send: give hex or text.

port_missing.message: {name}: its port is not available right now.

not_a_port.message: {name} is the admin panel, not a port.
